Average CellChat communication probabilities across objects

get_avg_df.Rd

Pools communication probabilities from multiple CellChat objects and returns the mean probability for each source, target, and pathway combination.

Usage

get_avg_df(obj_list, sources, targets)

Arguments

obj_list

A named list of CellChat objects.

sources

A character vector of source cell type names.

targets

A character vector of target cell type names.

Value

A data frame with columns source, target, pathway_name, and prob.
